units.title: SG-6.1.2 · BootScene emits a typed characterClick event to React
Act: Emit characterClick from the BootScene character pointerdown handler
Verify: characterClick event type unit tests

tests.name: delivers characterClick payload once and not to objectClick handlers
tests.title: delivers characterClick payload once and not to objectClick handlers
tests.scenario: Given a characterClick handler and an objectClick handler on the phaser-to-react bus, When characterClick is emitted with { id: 'boy' }, Then the characterClick handler is called once with { id: 'boy' } and the objectClick handler is not called
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserEvents.test.ts --testTimeout=10000
tests.detail: Passed on first run (5/5 tests in tests/phaserEvents.test.ts).

units.title: Verify: BootScene characterClick emission unit tests with Phaser mocked

tests.id: bootSceneCharacters.test.ts > BootScene character wiring > creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.name: creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.title: BootScene character wiring: creates one sprite per scene character and plays its idle animation key
tests.scenario: Given a scene with one boy character, When create() runs, Then one sprite is added and played with character:boy:idle

tests.id: bootSceneCharacters.test.ts > BootScene character wiring > plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.name: plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.title: BootScene character wiring: plays the boy interact animation when the character sprite is pressed
tests.scenario: Given BootScene created the boy sprite, When pointerdown fires, Then character:boy-interact:interact is played

tests.id: bootSceneCharacters.test.ts > BootScene character wiring > emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact on pointerdown
tests.name: emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact on pointerdown
tests.title: BootScene character wiring: emits characterClick with the spec id and still plays interact on pointerdown
tests.scenario: Given BootScene created the boy sprite and phaserToReact.emit is spied, When pointerdown fires, Then emit is called with ('characterClick', { id: 'boy' }) and the interact animation plays
